LeeApr 10, 2026, 11:00 PM UTCFacebookLinkComments00CommentsA new light heavyweight champion will be crowned this weekend.On Saturday, the UFC returns to Kaseya Center in Miami for UFC 327, headlined by a fight between former champion Jiri Prochazka and surging contender Carlos Ulberg for the vacant light heavyweight title. Alex Pereira vacated his belt to move up to heavyweight and chase history, and now it falls to Prochazka and Ulberg to pick up the 205-pound division in his absence, but can they?Ahead of UFC 327, MMA Fighting’s Jed Meshew and Alexander K. Lee preview Saturday’s marquee matchup between Prochazka and Ulberg, and discuss whether the winner will feel like the true 205 champion. Additionally, Meshew and Lee discuss the co-main event between Azamat Murzakanov and Paulo Costa, the rise of Josh Hokit, Cub Swanson’s retirement, answer fan questions, and more.Latest Video from SB NationGina Carano On Why She's Fighting Ronda Rousey, Changes In MMA, Future Plans NEXT StayNext 360p720pHD1080pHDAuto (360p) About ConnatixV324082750 About ConnatixV324082750 1/1 Skip Ad Continue watchingafter the adVisit Advertiser websiteGO TO PAGEGina Carano On Why She's Fighting Ronda Rousey, Changes In MMA, Future PlansView MoreView LessCatch the UFC 327 preview show video above.
